title: Canonical degree-zero theta on augmented sections of any module
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $y\in Y$, $\mathcal F$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Use the formal fibre $i_n:X_n\to X$, stalk $M=(R^0f_*\mathcal F)_y$, cohomology $C_n=H^0(X_n,i_n^*\mathcal F)$ over $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ and predicate IsFormalFunctionsTheta of [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. Tensor pullback and its fixed adjunction unit $\eta_n:\mathcal F\to i_{n*}i_n^*\mathcal F$ are those of [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $\alpha:(f_*\mathcal F)_y\to M$ for the stalk map of the canonical zeroth right-derived augmentation [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], and $\gamma_n:\Gamma(X_n,i_n^*\mathcal F)\to C_n$ for the canonical global-sections augmentation [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For every $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$-linear $\theta:M\to C_n$ satisfying IsFormalFunctionsTheta, every open $V\subseteq Y$ containing $y$ with $X_n=i_n^{-1}(f^{-1}V)$, and every section $t\in\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$, one has $\theta(\alpha(\operatorname{germ}_V(t)))=\gamma_n(\operatorname{res}^{i_n^{-1}(f^{-1}V)}_{X_n}(\eta_{n,f^{-1}V}(t)))$. The restriction is along the displayed containment, and the augmentations and unit are fixed, not chosen isomorphisms. No properness, flatness or coherence assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Choose resolutions I of F and J of the tensor pullback F′. Restrict each termwise to U=f inverse V and W=i_n inverse U. Exactness and preservation of injectives give the restricted resolutions. Use restrictAppIso and inclusion-image-top to identify their sections. Restrict the tensor-adjunction unit and transpose under the open restriction adjunction to define psi. The adjunction identity, followed by the canonical pushforward composition isomorphisms, gives the unit_square of FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices. This construction is the one in FlatBaseChangeOpenChoicesExist with its unused flatness hypotheses omitted; it uses no preservation of injectives by i_n pushforward.

Let xi be the degree-zero global-sections augmentation of the restriction of t to U. Expand toRightDerivedZero by InjectiveResolution.toRightDerivedZero_eq. The augmentation equation and pinned section components of the restricted resolution identify its zero-cycle with the original resolution augmentation of t on U. The sectionCohomologyTheta map is adjoint to the sheafification comparison, so counit naturality identifies the corresponding resolutionSectionClass with this cycle’s class in the cohomology sheaf. Composing with the inverse resolution comparison gives the direct-image augmentation of t on V. Naturality of the stalk functor and germ maps gives exactly alpha(germ_V(t)).

Apply IsFormalFunctionsTheta to I,J,V,hy,D,xi. The zero-augmentation square for moduleCohomologyFMap applied to psi identifies its right side with the augmentation of psi on restricted sections. Evaluate D.unit_square on t; all composition and restriction identifications are pinned, so this is the augmentation of the restriction of the original tensor-unit image eta_n(t). The containment gives W=top. The section restriction to W is then an isomorphism, and both canonical degree-zero augmentations are isomorphisms by left exactness. Their square makes cohomology restriction injective. Cancel that restriction to obtain the formula.

theorem formalFunctions_degreeZero_augmented_sections {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ)
    (θ : formalFunctionsStalk f y F 0 →ₗ[Y.presheaf.stalk y]
      formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y F 0 n)
    (hθ : IsFormalFunctionsTheta f y F 0 n θ)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
    (hV : (⊤ : (formalFibre f y n).Opens) ≤
      (formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (t : F.presheaf.obj (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    θ (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).map
      ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).toRightDerivedZero.app F)).hom
        (TopCat.Presheaf.germ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F).val.presheaf
          V y hy t)) =
    ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (formalFibre f y n).toRingedSpace).toRightDerivedZero.app
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F)).hom
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (formalFibreι f y n)).obj F).presheaf.map
        (homOfLE hV).op
          ((((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
            (formalFibreι f y n))).unit.app F).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))).hom t))
